hooks.prompt: Run the doc-sync agent to sync IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md and architecture docs with the latest commit changes

A file was just written or edited (see $ARGUMENTS for tool_input.file_path). Decide if this is a SIGNIFICANT code change per CLAUDE.md Rule #4 — e.g. a new module/service/agent, a new data model, a changed architectural decision, a new script under scripts/ or ingestion/, a new migration. Trivial edits (typo fixes, comment tweaks, formatting, doc-only edits) do NOT count. If significant, invoke the doc-sync agent to update IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md, AGENTS.md, and the doc/feature/ OKF bundle. If not significant, do nothing and exit quietly.
